📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

🧭 STRATEGY

Confirmed: Precious metals GLD and SLV both ABOVE TREND (GLD 1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%; SLV 1W: +4.41% | 1M: +18.27%). MAJOR divergence across risk assets: multiple core ETFs (SPY CORRECTION, QQQ CORRECTION, XLK CORRECTION, while TLT RECOVERY and IBIT ABOVE TREND) → transitional/mixed market signals, so avoid forceful regime calls.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to commodity/defensive beneficiaries showing strength (GLD, SLV, XLE) and growth in selective innovation/crypto vehicles (IBIT, ETHA) while reducing exposure to stretched Tech risk: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) CORRECTION and QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.23%) CORRECTION; monitor TLT for duration exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BULLISH: Materials / Precious Metals — GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND; XME showing divergence (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +15.85%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: Tech — XLK CORRECTION (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) CORRECTION and SOXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Gold/Silver — GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND, SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +18.27%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Select industrials/copper if CPER fails to sustain (CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +4.49%) CORRECTION).

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX ~20 for complacency (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -15.21%)); HYG/LQD spread near current stable band (HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND); XLK downside pivot vs XLE relative move (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -5.40% | 1M: +2.37%) vs XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +5.85%)).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (broad strength) with mixed risk signals from equities, bonds and commodities. Precious metals and selective cyclicals showing strength while Tech is showing weakness; major divergence between rate-sensitive and growth ETFs is the key risk to monitor.
